card.name: Treatment nouns where duration may follow
card.fires_on: Nouns naming a drug course or therapy, such as infusion, treatment, or inhibitor, and the middle of antiviral. It fires where the next word could be about how long it lasts.

modes.description: The word inhibitor after an enzyme name, in advice about use for a period of time.

modes.label: Inside antiviral
modes.description: The middle of the word antiviral in hepatitis B text.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words about duration and length of time, such as duration, durations, longer, and until.
card.plain: It marks drug-course words like infusion or treatment that are often followed by how long the course lasts.
